description: Fork of exp498. gate_mode=gelu: UNNORMALIZED g=GELU(ts+b[n_tables,K]), out=g@W. No /sum (user doubted post-GELU normalization, which gave 50pct negative weights in exp498). Instrument at init: g.sum~34/table -> common-mode like unnorm relu (exp496 +0.12); BUT learnable per-table bias can go negative to reduce firing/common-mode. Tests if GELU+learnable-bias trains out of common-mode. vs softmax exp493 1.4806.
